Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

Typed preflight reports now cover the shipped fixation, recording, temporal, and repetition families, including missing viewing and observed coverage. The ticket's Session/project-wide query and event-aligned MarkSelector/SyncEvidence contract are not evidenced as one complete query.

Evidence:
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/Preflight.scala:456 typed preflight reports
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/RecordingPlan.scala:354 recording preflight
- plan/src/test/scala/eyes4s/plan/PreflightSuite.scala:425 availability assertions

Remaining / next action: Define and test the project-level availability query for AoiSet, selectors, observed matches, clock precision, and missing schema versions.

Disposition: Keep open.
